text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain felt satisfying, but a small profit alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider whether the position still fits my plan.","I held through several account declines without trading. Since past price moves do not predict future ones, I should avoid reacting to losses alone and reassess each holding on its merits.","I check my account often and tend to trade repeatedly, so I should use a clear plan and avoid letting the urge to lock in gains or avoid realizing losses drive my decisions."]}
